dracula.name: Dracula Theme
dracula.note: Colour codes are from the project's published Color Palette (OSS); several were darkened for the MarsDawn theme system's own contrast requirements.

nord.name: Nord
nord.note: Nord publishes a dark palette only; this theme's light mode is an original companion built from Nord's own 16 colours. Several colours were darkened for the MarsDawn theme system's own contrast requirements.

gruvbox.name: Gruvbox
gruvbox.license_source: github.com/morhetz/gruvbox package.json (“license”: “MIT”); the repository ships no separate LICENSE file, so the copyright line below uses the author named in package.json and the repository's creation year (2012).
gruvbox.note: Colour codes are from colors/gruvbox.vim's official palette table; several were darkened or lightened for the MarsDawn theme system's own contrast requirements.

solarized.name: Solarized
solarized.note: Colour codes are from the project's published SCSS variables; several were brightened or darkened, by luminance only, for the MarsDawn theme system's own contrast requirements — every accent's hue and the base3/base03 background tones are unmodified.
